applicant.name: Dr. Lukas Gruber
applicant.organisation: Austrian Diabetes Association, health services research

purpose: Health services research on treatment persistence in type 2 diabetes care.
question: In each region, how many patients were ever prescribed metformin and how many of those are still on it at the end of 2025?
definitions: Ever prescribed = any prescription of metformin, whenever it started and whether or not it has ended.
Still on it = prescription active on 31 December 2025 (started on or before that day, and not ended before it).
Report per region: patients ever prescribed metformin, patients with an active metformin prescription, and the active ones as a share of the ever-prescribed in %, one decimal.
